answer: Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the shale of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The sable holds work receipts rather than names, so the quartz of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. The design leans on web-of-trust with decaying edges, burned when the recruit misbehaves, the unit of trust is a task, not an address.
